# nuclock_user (Data Source)

A person by their email, whole and in any case.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nuclock_user" "ann" {
  email = "ann@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Their address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `public_name` (String)
